scope: Allow user-authored, individually reviewed rewrites for selected approved project and accomplishment facts used as resume bullets, while preserving source identity, exact date/number tokens, durable document provenance and historical comparison.

acceptance.project_and_accomplishment_rewrites_acce: PASS - API/domain validation now supports these two additional fact kinds; unit tests prove unselected rewrites are rejected.
acceptance.user_review_required_and_dates_numbers_p: PASS - review remains mandatory; exact date and numeric token preservation is enforced for each rewritten fact.
acceptance.source_hash_fact_id_and_kind_recorded: PASS - generated provenance stores fact ID, source text SHA-256 and server-bound fact kind; rebuilding from saved history succeeds.
acceptance.generated_resume_and_cover_letter_are_se: PASS - both rewrites appear in the revised resume; neither rewrite is applied to the cover letter or source profile.
acceptance.durable_history_survives_reload_and_prof: PASS - connected browser reload and API comparison read back before/after facts from immutable document history after a live profile change.
acceptance.external_network_and_submission: PASS - browser test blocked non-local routes and observed none; no provider inference or external submission was used.

test_first_red.observation: Before implementation, the regression failed with RESUME_REPHRASE_FACT_INVALID because project/accomplishment were not in the supported rewrite kinds.

commands.summary: Installed lockfile-pinned frontend dependencies in the isolated worktree; npm audit reported 0 vulnerabilities.

commands.command: python -m py_compile services/documents/tailor.py tests/unit/test_resume_comparison.py tests/integration/test_resume_comparison.py tests/browser/test_skill_order.py; python -m tools.verification.agent_skills; python -m tools.verification.catalogue; python -m tools.verification.progress validate; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate; git diff --check

limitations: Issue #96 / MJ-REQ-095 remains OPEN/PARTIAL; other tailoring requirement gaps remain.
User attestation preserves explicit review but is not automated semantic-equivalence verification.
No real AI provider, ATS, PostgreSQL runtime, Docker workflow or hosted CI/review was exercised.
